rules.statement: A transaction involving advances made by a tea estate proprietor to another for the purchase of green tea leaf falls under section 8 of the Prescription Ordinance, not section 9, and thus has a three-year prescriptive period.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion, the appeal must succeed. The facts show that in terms of an agreement which was not reduced to writing plaintiff from time to time advanced sums of money to defendant to enable the latter to purchase tea for the plaintiff. This is a matter which seems to me to fall within section 8 of the Ordinance."
